anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home System · Twin Golden Reference
anomalies.description: Ten light-years behind you, Sol and Alpha Centauri burn steady in visible light—the one pair of anchors on your star chart that still feels close to home.

anomalies.label: CARINA RIFT NURSERY
anomalies.subtitle: Dust-Veiled Stellar Cliffs
anomalies.description: Thick interstellar dust hides newborn stars in visible light. Sweep into infrared to look straight through the dark cloud and catch whatever sharp signal is sitting behind it.

anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Gravitational Lens · Faint Straight Arc
anomalies.description: A massive galaxy cluster bends background starlight into bright rings. Untwist the optical warp in Near-IR—something behind those arcs looks suspiciously ruler-straight.

anomalies.label: PULSAR RIFT S-04
anomalies.subtitle: High-Energy Flare & Repeating Grid
anomalies.description: Fast ultraviolet pulses crackle along the outer survey sector. Lock onto the beacon timing to test whether that faint repeating lattice is sensor noise or actually out there.

anomalies.label: ANTIPODAL POLE SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: 180° Opposite Sky Check
anomalies.description: Dead opposite Cluster J1419-A on the far side of your sky. Split the incoming light to check whether the same impossible geometry repeats 180 degrees away.
